::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 2nd [1869]  
**From:** Testwood  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 232
:::

Miss Yonge would be much obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](organizations/other_111.qmd) would send three copies of the [Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd) directed to 

[Miss Buffham](people/person_2048.qmd)
[Miss Sturges Bourne](people/person_1379.qmd)’s
Testwood
Southampton
